rules: Every generated playbook output declared in source must have exactly one entry in verification/ARTIFACT_MATERIALIZATION_REGISTRY.json.
Document-like outputs use materialization_mode=template with a package-local template file.
Package/archive/binary outputs may use materialization_mode=assembler with a package-local assembler/assembly contract instead of a document template.
Each registry entry declares output path/type, field or content contract, producers, validators and post-render/post-assembly validation.
A declared output without a materialization contract blocks PRE_EDITOR.
A template/assembler reference outside the generated package is invalid.
Generated artifacts must not introduce fields or semantics absent from the declared contract without an explicit revision.
Template/materialization design occurs before final build/readiness and is not merely documentation.
Pre-materialization/outputless package validation is contract-driven: generated_outputs/ is not required when there are no active confirmed rendered-artifact requirements or rendered assertions.

If any active confirmed rendered-artifact requirement or rendered assertion exists, missing generated_outputs/ remains a fail-closed validation error; empty placeholder directories must never substitute for required materialized evidence.
